title: Pure Ecclesia
summary: Pure Ecclesia strategy uniting the virtuous LIGHT Spellcaster incarnations of the Albaz lore: Incredible Ecclesia, Dogmatika Ecclesia, Blazing Cartesia, and Guiding Quem, alongside their signature Level 8 Synchro Ecclesia and the Dark Dragon. Supported by Fallen of the White Dragon and The Fallen & The Virtuous, the deck cycles between Level 8 Synchro and Fusion plays on both players' turns while triggering recursive End Phase floats.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fallen of the White Dragon sends a Fusion Monster mentioning Fallen of Albaz (Titaniklad or Albion) from Extra Deck to GY to Special Summon itself, then Special Summons any Ecclesia monster directly from your hand, Deck, or GY.
Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous Special Summons itself from hand while an Extra Deck monster is on field, and searches any Dogmatika card (Dogmatika Fleurdelis or Dogmatika Punishment) on summon.

Incredible Ecclesia, the Virtuous Special Summons itself while the opponent controls more monsters, tributes itself as a Quick Effect to summon Fallen of Albaz from Deck, and recurs from GY in the End Phase.
Guiding Quem, the Virtuous sends Fallen of Albaz or a card mentioning it from Deck to GY on summon, and revives an Ecclesia or Albaz monster from GY whenever a card leaves the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Fallen of the White Dragon + Dogmatika Ecclesia
steps: Activate Fallen of the White Dragon, sending Titaniklad the Ash Dragon from Extra Deck to GY to Special Summon itself from hand.
Trigger Fallen of the White Dragon to Special Summon Blazing Cartesia, the Virtuous directly from your Deck.
Normal Summon Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous and activate its effect to search Dogmatika Punishment from your Deck.
Synchro Summon Ecclesia and the Dark Dragon using Level 4 Tuner Blazing Cartesia and Level 4 Fallen of the White Dragon.
During the opponent's turn, activate Ecclesia and the Dark Dragon as a Quick Effect to banish itself and Special Summon Fallen of Albaz from Deck to fuse with an opponent's monster.
During the End Phase, trigger Titaniklad in the GY to Special Summon Guiding Quem from your Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ecclesia and the Dark Dragon is a Level 8 Synchro boss that banishes itself until the End Phase as a Quick Effect to Special Summon Fallen of Albaz or a Level 4 monster mentioning it from Deck or GY, and shuffles an opponent's card on field into the Deck from the GY.

Granguignol the Dusk Dragon is a Level 8 Fusion summoned by Blazing Cartesia that dumps a Level 6+ LIGHT or DARK monster from Deck or Extra Deck, and banishes itself from field or GY to cheat out a Dogmatika or Despia monster.

Mirrorjade the Iceblade Dragon sends an Albaz Fusion from Extra Deck to GY as a Quick Effect to banish an opponent's monster without targeting, and wipes all opposing monsters during the End Phase if removed by the opponent.

Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Knighted Special Summons itself from hand as a Quick Effect while an Extra Deck monster is on field and negates a face-up monster's effects while boosting Dogmatikas by 500 ATK.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: The Fallen & The Virtuous is a Quick-Play Spell that sends an Albaz Fusion from Extra Deck to GY to destroy a face-up card on the field, or revives any monster from either GY while you control an Ecclesia monster.
Nadir Servant sends an Extra Deck monster to the GY to search Dogmatika Ecclesia from Deck or GY, triggering the GY effects of Titaniklad or Granguignol.
Dogmatika Punishment sends an Extra Deck monster to the GY to target and destroy an opponent's monster with equal or lower ATK.
